subject: german
title: Holiday Types & Destinations
welcome_lead: Learn to say where you go on holiday — sea, mountains, abroad — with the right prepositions.
meta_desc: GCSE German holidays: types of holiday and destination phrases with the right prepositions.
final_note: 'Ich fahre gern ans Meer' — these fixed phrases are gold. Memorise the preposition with each location.

concepts.def: To the sea — an + das = ans (accusative).
To the mountains — accusative for direction.
To the countryside — auf + das = aufs.
Abroad — in + das = ins (Ausland is neuter).
To travel / go (by vehicle) — ich fahre, du fährst.

walkthroughs.body_html:
fahren = travel by vehicle (most holidays).

fliegen = fly.

gehen = go on foot.

For holidays, usually fahren or fliegen: Ich fahre in die Berge / Ich fliege ins Ausland.

Memorise these fixed phrases:

  • ans Meer — to the sea
  • in die Berge — to the mountains
  • aufs Land — to the countryside
  • in die Stadt — to the city
  • ins Ausland — abroad

Example: Im Sommer fahre ich gern ans Meer.

Use im + season:

  • im Sommer — in summer
  • im Winter — in winter
  • im Frühling — in spring
  • im Herbst — in autumn

School holidays: in den Sommerferien, in den Osterferien.
